name: rn-dev-agent
description: React Native development and testing plugin for live CDP introspection, device control, Maestro action replay, and proof capture.

interface.shortDescription: Verify React Native apps with live device evidence
interface.longDescription: Use React Native app introspection, native simulator/emulator control, Maestro action replay, and proof-capture workflows from Codex. Both hosts install the same packages/claude-plugin directory: Claude Code keeps its slash-command, agent, and hook surface there, and Codex selects its own codex-skills/ and codex.mcp.json from the same package.
defaultPrompt: Set up rn-dev-agent for this React Native app.
Verify this React Native feature on a simulator.
Debug the current React Native screen with live evidence.
